name: 刀蛐蛐
detailed_description:
I. Core Gameplay: Master Strategy & Raise the Ultimate Hero!​​

  • ​​Enhanced Classics, Strategy First!​​ Inspired by Meme Mayhem and Skill Selection Challenge, we've deepened the strategy for a more thrilling Rogue-lite experience! Play as a dao-style hero, embark on a journey to the top through 30 intense duels, and claim the title of ​​"Solo King"!​​

  • ​​Auto-Battle, Focus on Strategy!​​ ​​Witness Fierce Combat Unfold Automatically​​ – no frantic clicking needed! Become a shrewd "Cricket Trainer," dedicating your focus to the core strategic elements:

    • ​​Build unique ability card decks​​

    • ​​Equip powerful artifacts​

    • ​​Customize special Rune enhancements​​

    • ​​Personally forge the ultimate hero to crush your foes!​​

  • ​​Plan Every Step, Grow Stronger!​​ Each victory is a stepping stone to power. Every choice shapes your hero's unique path!

​​II. Deep Deck-Building: Smart Resource Use, Build Unbeatable Synergies!​​

  • ​​Cards, Your Core Foundation:​​ Defeat common foes and seize critical ​​Card Drafts (Pick 1 of 3)!​​ ​​Collect Wisely. Trim Strategically.​​ Forge your combat engine!

  • ​​Artifacts, Power Through Equipment:​​ ​​Defeat Bosses, Snag Epic Loot!​​ Collect specific sets to ​​Fuse & Evolve them into more powerful Artifacts!​​

  • ​​Skills, Evolve Your Arsenal:​​ Heroes carry the initial skills. During your run, not only can you ​​Upgrade existing skills​​, but also ​​Unlock other new ones!​​

  • ​​Runes, Strategic Enhancement:​​ ​​Drawing Cards is Tactical Planning!​​ When you form a specific card type, you can obtain mysterious runes! Paste them onto the card to significantly enhance its effectiveness. Runes can also be used to disable not useful cards in the card pool, aiming to streamline and optimize your building direction!

​​III. Key Features: Infinite Combos, Strategy Reigns Supreme!​​

  • ​​Minimalist operation, deep strategy: Say goodbye to operational anxiety! Fully automated combat brings a refreshing visual experience and a sense of decompression, allowing you to devote 100% of your energy to deep strategic decision-making and enjoy the thrill of strategizing.

  • Versatile combinations, multiple genres: over a hundred cards and artifacts waiting to be discovered! Free mix and match, freely combine, develop infinite possibilities of tactical genres, and create your own unique tactics!

  • Intelligent control card pool, planning for victory: drawing cards is not just about luck! Rune system helps you deeply intervene in card pool composition! Transform random card draws into a construction gameplay full of strategic depth and planning fun, with each choice having a profound impact!
